fa886454de67.name: Fuelmeup

34073d60797d.name: Farhad | Crypto News
34073d60797d.text: Anthropic just took Claude into the office, and straight at Microsoft and Google. On November 10, Anthropic launched Claude Sheets and Claude Whiteboards in beta, made Claude Data generally available, and previewed Claude Meetings.
34073d60797d.note: Best rundown of the full product list and the target: Office and Workspace.

34073d60797d.name: Shweta Bajaj
34073d60797d.text: Anthropic is starting to roll out Claude Meetings in beta for Team and Enterprise users. The idea is bigger than transcription. Claude can join the video call and help create documents, whiteboards, and other working artifacts while the team is still discussing them.
34073d60797d.note: Explains why Meetings is a step past note-takers like Copilot recaps.

34073d60797d.name: Bharat kambariya

34073d60797d.name: Untangling Web3
34073d60797d.text: Also this week: Anthropic launched a video call assistant, a data dashboard and Claude Sheets to take on Microsoft, and the US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China, per The Verge.
34073d60797d.note: Puts the launch next to the week's other AI headlines.

d5cd2755f894.name: The Current Account
d5cd2755f894.text: $MSFT has been the main culprit pulling out of leases, which has hurt Nscale the most, especially considering their customer concentration with MSFT. They've recently pulled out of >$130Bn in commitments, with the biggest being the LOI they had for Nscale's West Virginia site.
d5cd2755f894.note: Key diligence risk: customer concentration in Microsoft as it pulls back leases.

d5cd2755f894.name: Ken Sobajima | I read S-1 filings

d5cd2755f894.note: Filing detail: the $1.65B Anyscale acquisition only closes if the IPO happens.

d5cd2755f894.text: Nvidia-backed AI cloud firm Nscale considers delaying $35 billion listing, report says. Anthropic's IPO is seen as a key test of Wall Street's faith in the AI boom it helped ignite.
